title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 2000 Though highest Women Jails were reported in Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu (2 each) followed by Bihar, Kerala, Orissa, Punjab, Rajasthan, Sikkim, Tripura, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal and Delhi (1 each), the total capacity of women inmates was highest in Tamil Nadu (513) followed by Delhi (400), Andhra Pradesh (320), Rajasthan (200), Punjab (150), West Bengal (100), Bihar (83), Uttar Pradesh (70), Kerala (64), Orissa (55) and Tripura (30).
